description: Package kcchien/claude-code-statusline (MIT, monolithic 2-line bash renderer) as a local nix package, and make it the base renderer for programs.claudeStatusline: upstream output becomes lines 1-2, remaining segments (e.g. voice.nix SuperWhisper) join on line 3. Enable CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_NERDFONT when the configured font profiles actually provide a Nerd Font.
title: Package claude-code-statusline and wire it into the statusline
